description:
# Pocketgull Clinical & Benchmark Dataset (MED-SKEPTIC)

## Context & Overview
This dataset provides de-identified 3D MRI volumetric metadata, multi-label diagnostic annotations, and synthetic clinical consult vectors engineered to evaluate foundation model diagnostic accuracy, Popperian falsifiability ($p < 0.05$), and Socratic evidence literacy.

## Content & File Structure
- `train.csv`: 4,400+ study-level multi-label pathology annotations (ACL, MCL, Meniscus tears, Osteoarthritis, Effusion).
- `train_series.csv`: DICOM MRI volumetric acquisition parameters, series UIDs, and plane orientations (Sagittal, Coronal, Axial).
- `train_labels_gemini.csv`: Gemini 2.5 Flash distilled weak labels with clinical rationale confidence scores.
- `asymmetric_loss.py`: PyTorch/NumPy implementation of Asymmetric Loss (ASL: gamma_minus=4.0, gamma_plus=1.0).

## Data Dictionary
| Column Name | Data Type | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `StudyInstanceUID` | String | Unique anonymized study subject hash |
| `SeriesInstanceUID` | String | Unique DICOM volumetric series acquisition identifier |
| `ACL` | Integer (0 or 1) | Binary indicator for Anterior Cruciate Ligament tear |
| `MCL` | Integer (0 or 1) | Binary indicator for Medial Collateral Ligament tear |
| `Medial Meniscus` | Integer (0 or 1) | Binary indicator for Medial Meniscus tear |
| `Lateral Meniscus` | Integer (0 or 1) | Binary indicator for Lateral Meniscus tear |
| `Medial OA` | Integer (0 or 1) | Binary indicator for Medial Compartment Osteoarthritis |
| `Lateral OA` | Integer (0 or 1) | Binary indicator for Lateral Compartment Osteoarthritis |
| `PF OA` | Integer (0 or 1) | Binary indicator for Patellofemoral Osteoarthritis |
| `Effusion` | Integer (0 or 1) | Presence of joint effusion / fluid accumulation |
| `Synovitis` | Integer (0 or 1) | Synovial membrane inflammation or thickening |
| `Baker's` | Integer (0 or 1) | Popliteal synovial fluid distension (Baker's cyst) |
| `Contusion` | Integer (0 or 1) | Subchondral bone marrow edema pattern |
| `Fracture` | Integer (0 or 1) | Cortical bone discontinuity |

## HIPAA §164.514 Safe Harbor Compliance
All data strictly conforms to HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514(b)(2) Safe Harbor anonymization. All 18 direct personal identifiers (names, dates, MRNs, institutional headers) have been permanently removed.

## Provenance & Citation
Published by PocketGull LLC & the RSNA Radiology Archive under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY 4.0). Free for global research, academic evaluation, and model benchmarking.
